content.text:
I reviewed the file — it's already well-built (accessible, respects reduced-motion, syncs across tabs, restarts animation cleanly on speed change). I found a few real issues to fix:

1. In the no-JS state, the button's `title`/`aria-label` say "Click to change pulse speed," which is misleading since clicking does nothing without JS.
2. The reduced-motion listener uses only `addEventListener`, which fails silently on older Safari (needs `addListener` fallback).
3. The button's title doesn't reflect the *current* speed, so users get no feedback via tooltip on which speed is active.

Made three fixes to `0.html`:

1. **No-JS button title was misleading** — it said "Click to change pulse speed" even when JS hadn't loaded and the button did nothing. Now it starts as a plain description and JS upgrades it once ready.
